prose: Launch HN for Momentic (YC W24): QA agents that autonomously plan, explore and bug-bash user flows across web, iOS, Android and soon desktop apps. The pitch is agents that catch bugs by actually using your app - the cached example shows a login routing change on a feature branch silently bypassing a new-device 2FA prompt, caught before merge. Another entry in the fast-crowding agentic QA category.
highlights: Momentic (YC W24): QA agents that explore web/mobile apps and catch bugs autonomously
Example catch: a feature-branch routing change that silently skipped new-device 2FA
